The work is area 7 and passes codes 1 to 5: the learned element is the FL model trained across the clients, and the paper designs the over-the-air aggregation, p. 1: "solutions for the optimal transmit scalars at the clients and the" de-noising scalar at the parameter server (Lemma 2, p. 4). But the link is single-antenna with no RIS, p. 4: "Without loss of generality, we assume that clients and PS" ... "are equipped with a single antenna", with a scalar channel h_{t,k} in a fading Gaussian MAC (Eq. 11, p. 4). No RIS or multi-antenna case is modeled or simulated anywhere in the paper.
